items.headline: Heat Advisory issued September 10 at 9:20PM PDT until September 11 at 6:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures of 85-95 degrees and very warm overnight
lows.

* WHERE...Los Angeles County Beaches, Los Angeles County Inland Coast
including Downtown Los Angeles, Malibu Coast, Palos Verdes Hills,
Santa Barbara County Southeastern Coast, Ventura County Beaches,
and Ventura County Inland Coast.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures may cause heat illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Humid conditions will add to heat discomfort.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.
